baseline_predicate: A Pan or Pot reports the target burner as a parent and its reported position is within 0.5 m of the reported burner position.
evaluator_predicate: At least one Pan or Pot has the target burner among its true parentReceptacles.
contract_difference: The baseline adds a 0.5 m geometric condition; its policy is not identical to the evaluator's necessary precondition.
